title: Initial remainder state space
statement: For each natural number $k$, define the initial remainder state space as the disjoint union of two one-symbol writing-phase state spaces, six seeking-phase state spaces, three sweep-phase state spaces, a scan-phase state space indexed by the unit type, and the tail state space at parameter $k$.
caveat: The snippet does not include definitions of the phase state spaces or the tail state space, so their precise meanings cannot be stated here.
